messages:
alice: heads up — multiple customers reporting p99 spikes and intermittent 502s this morning. ticket #3456 includes a req id: rQz-8391. they say requests end up in us-west even though their tenant is eu-west. anyone seeing region flips?
ben: yep, seen it. traces show SDKs doing hedged requests. primary goes to eu-west, hedged attempt to another region resolves to us-west. hedge_after_ms looks like 300ms in the client.
charlie: can you paste the SDK config and a short log snippet? that sounds like session/region affinity is lost on retry.
ben: snippet from support reproduction:```json
{
  "region": "auto",
  "hedged_requests": true,
  "hedge_after_ms": 300,
  "max_retries": 3,
  "backoff": {"base_ms": 200, "factor": 2}
}
```
dana: customer reported ~90% hits to eu, but ~12% flipped to us-west on retries. those flipped requests add ~180-300ms causing p99 to blow up and some timeouts -> 502.
evan: quick workaround is to set `region: \"eu-west\"` in SDK or disable hedged requests. we should preserve region selection across retries though.
helen: i repro'd locally — curl with `X-Client-Region: eu-west` then run concurrent load with hedged enabled, logs show later attempts pick us-west. my log line: `route: eu-west -> retry -> route: us-west (resolved)`
alice: initial theory: DNS TTL + per-attempt resolver + our routing LB that uses recent endpoint health. SDK retry triggers a fresh DNS resolve and gets a different endpoint in us-west. also SDK drops region header on retry in some languages.
charlie: immediate plan: (1) patch SDK to carry region header/state into retry attempts, (2) make SDK preserve chosen endpoint for hedged attempts when region is pinned, (3) routing change to honor explicit `X-Region` header on fallback. who can own SDK patch?
ben: i'll take the SDK patch. i'll also add a runtime toggle to disable hedged by default for hosted clients until we roll out the routing fix. pushing PR now.
devops-bot: deploy started: routing/edge v1.9.3 -> canary eu-west (deploy id d-20260317).
dana: support reply drafted: "we recommend setting region explicitly and disabling hedged requests as a temporary workaround. we're deploying a fix to preserve region on retries; i'll update within 2 hours."
evan: i'll add a CI e2e that simulates hedged retries + cross-region DNS variance so we don't regress.
helen: sending repro script + condensed logs here: https://redwood-internal.s3/secure/logs/repro-3456.tgz — includes curl command and node SDK trace.
ben: hotfix merged to main for SDK region-preserve. routing canary metrics look promising: p99 dropped from 3.2s to 260ms in canary traffic. rolling to prod in 10m.
alice: great. i'll update the ticket and the internal incident doc, and notify the customer about the rollback-safe fix. :thumbsup:
charlie: follow-up items: add telemetry to count cross-region fallback hits per tenant, make hedged default off for web SDKs, and add an annotation to routing logs for `attempt_id` so we can tie retries to routes.
dana: noted for the support playbook — add a checkbox to ask for SDK version and hedged settings when a region-flip symptom appears.
evan: after prod roll, i'll run a 100k request smoke test against a test tenant to verify no flips.
alice: thanks everyone. tagging this as resolved for now; will reopen if we see new reports.
